description: Defines the XFontStretchValue enum and the XFontStretches static class for handling font stretch styles in PDFsharp library.

classes.name: XFontStretches
classes.description: Provides static predefined font stretch values and utility methods for string conversion and face name parsing.

methods.name: XFontStretchStringToKnownStretch
methods.description: Converts a string to a known XFontStretch value if possible.

methods.name: XFontStretchToString
methods.description: Converts an XFontStretchValue enum to its string representation.

methods.name: FontStretchFromFaceName
methods.description: Parses a font face name to determine the corresponding XFontStretch value.
